sisi.depan: A floor-to-ceiling curved screen projects a vast holographic map of islands and glowing signal paths, framed by two wide pillars of dark teak wood with intricate, geometric carvings.
sisi.kanan: A long, recessed bank of vertical data ports glows with soft, pulsing white light, set into a wall of polished black volcanic stone with fine gold inlay.
sisi.belakang: A single, wide doorway with a sliding panel of smoked glass is set into the wall, beside which the golden Galians crest is subtly embedded into the dark paneling.
sisi.kiri: Two deep, semi-circular alcoves are built into the wall, each containing a smaller, curved console screen and a single, low stool upholstered in dark, woven fabric.

tengah: A single, high-backed console chair made of polished dark wood and black cushions sits on a circular, raised platform facing the front screen.
atas: The ceiling is a multi-tiered, coffered structure made of dark wood, with thin strips of cool blue light recessed along the inner edges of each square coffer.
